findings.detail: Each replica's codebook is initialized by KMeans on the complete training-item matrix before the bootstrap sample is drawn. Thus every replica sees all training items during initialization; only subsequent optimization uses the resample. This is not a replica fit on its bootstrap resample, and weakens the intended resampling estimate of tokenizer uncertainty.
findings.reproduction: For any bootstrap draw that omits an item, that omitted item's embedding still participates in replica.init_codebook(train_embeddings.to(device)) at line 254 and can affect all initial centers and subsequent assignments.
findings.correction: Draw sampled indices before initialization and initialize each replica's codebook from its bootstrap sample (sampled embeddings), then train that replica on the same resample. Keep final-model codebook initialization on the ordinary training set.
